svg.text: 01 / USB-C EPR Power and USB Data
J1 is 48 V / 5 A EPR power; J10 is isolated USB 2.0 device data and 5 V attach sense.
U1: 48 V CC/VBUS protection. U2: TPS26750 EPR sink controller. U3: PD policy EEPROM. U4: hardware power-permit gate.
Q1: protected VBUS blocking control. Q2/Q3: PD path level translation and valid-path indication.
